tools.name: get_scene
tools.description: Reads the railway switchyard state, including all numbered user annotations (#1, #2, ...) with optional notes, track connections, occupancy, closures, and switch alignment. Call first whenever the user refers to 'this', 'here', or numbered pins (#1, #2), or before planning maneuvers. If a needed target or destination annotation is missing, ask the user before moving any train.

tools.name: set_switch
tools.description: Aligns a railway turnout switch to a target branch when its approach track is clear of trains and active reservations. Use before routing a train toward a platform or exit branch that differs from the current switch position.

branchId.description: Target branch track to align the switch toward

tools.name: move_train
tools.description: Moves a train to a target destination track along an open, clear, and switch-aligned route, reserving traversed tracks until arrival. Use to dispatch a train once its destination is confirmed and required switches are aligned.

trainId.description: Train identifier or color name to dispatch

destinationId.description: Target stopping track or platform identifier
